description: Use after a scan reports STALE_CACHE_SERVED (visitors and crawlers get an old cached homepage). Fetches the homepage now and returns its Age, the cache layers that name themselves in the headers in purge order (innermost first), the HTML lifetime each response declares, a fresh-read comparison, and whether a purge clears the finding and keeps it cleared. Read-only; it does not purge anything. Give domain, or a report id (the page is still fetched now because cache state is live).

id.description: Report id; the page is still fetched now, because cache state is live
